# Notify reads a VEX and prints the Slack message with --dry-run

exec vens notify --vex vex.cdx.json --to slack --dry-run
stdout '\*vens scan:\* 2 vulnerabilities scored'
stdout 'critical: 1'
stdout 'low: 1'
stdout 'CVE-2024-1234'
stdout '63.0 .critical.'

# An unknown target is rejected with the supported list
! exec vens notify --vex vex.cdx.json --to jira --dry-run
stderr 'unknown notify target'
stderr 'jira'

# A missing VEX file fails cleanly
! exec vens notify --vex does-not-exist.cdx.json --to slack --dry-run
stderr 'failed to read VEX file'

-- vex.cdx.json --
{
  "bomFormat": "CycloneDX",
  "specVersion": "1.6",
  "version": 1,
  "vulnerabilities": [
    {
      "bom-ref": "urn:cdx:abc/1#pkg-a",
      "id": "CVE-2024-1234",
      "ratings": [
        {"method": "OWASP", "score": 63.0, "severity": "critical"}
      ],
      "affects": [{"ref": "urn:cdx:abc/1#pkg-a"}]
    },
    {
      "bom-ref": "urn:cdx:abc/1#pkg-b",
      "id": "CVE-2024-5678",
      "ratings": [
        {"method": "OWASP", "score": 12.0, "severity": "low"}
      ]
    }
  ]
}
